newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Nov 7.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Nov 7.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on November 7. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Suharto said investors in the tourism industry should be protected from being subjected to "illegal collections", an euphemism for bribes.
Manpower Minister Abdul Latief said Indonesia's open unemployment was at 7.2 percent of the country's 86.4 million workforce, or 6.3 million people out of work.
President Suharto congratulated Bill Clinton on his re-election as U.S. President. Suharto said that he hoped the two countries could overcome any differences that might exist.

An Indonesian actress arrested in a Houston supermarket after fleeing a charge of Ecstasy possesion in Indonesia, will stand trial in the United States. Police had earlier said she would be deported immediately because she had entered the United States on a false passport.
Indonesia's central bank governor, Sudradjad Djiwandono, said the country's interest rates could not be lowered immediately as suggested by a minister.
